description: Store anchors and runs of entries checked against them, variants of the audit suite's world (core conformance/audit_world.py build_world: 11 entries, 3 anchors signed across an NA key succession), each judged by the Python reference (verify_store_anchors, check_events_against_anchors after verify_evidence_events); the TypeScript SDK agrees on every case. A chain case verifies its anchors under keys: history (the key history), list (both NA keys, valid always), old (the first key only) or skip (no signature checked), and sovereign_id (null: not checked); expected.raises for an anchor the reference does not read. A run case checks lines (indexes into the pool) against its anchors, with partial and from_anchor. Left out: an anchored_at written +00:00, which the reference reads as Z before it checks the signature.
